title: IA ENHANCED DIAMOND 12TOOLS
description: These enhanced diamond tools are a better version of the normal minecraft diamond tools.
body:
## IA ENHANCED DIAMOND TOOLS

IA Enhanced Diamond Tools is a simple texture pack that upgrades the look of Minecraft’s diamond tools.
The design keeps the vanilla style but makes them sharper, cleaner, and more distinct.

### Features

* Redesigned Diamond Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, and Hoe.
* Sharper and more detailed textures while staying true to vanilla.
* Easy to recognize during gameplay.
* Works with any Minecraft version that supports resource packs.

Perfect if you want your tools to feel upgraded without breaking the vanilla style.
